brief.headline: Northwind Group Closed Its Third Real Estate Debt Fund at $1 Billion, Double Its $500 Million Target
bullets: Fundraising: New York-based Northwind Group has held the final close of Northwind Debt Fund III with $1 billion of committed capital.

M&A & Buyouts: Blackstone has led a $300m private credit financing package backing Arlington Capital Partners' take-private acquisition of UK aerospace and defence components manufacturer Gooch & Housego, according to a report by Bloomberg.

Hedge Funds: Blackstone Multi-Strategy Hedge Fund L.P. sold about $106.5m of unregistered limited partnership units on October 1 in its continuous private offering, according to an 8-K filed October 22.

Real Estate: Rexford Industrial Realty continued its transformation from Southern California’s biggest industrial buyer into one of its largest sellers during the third quarter after completing $1.3 billion in property sales.

Real Estate: A joint venture involving Avery Hall Investments, Bridge Investment Group and Declaration Partners has sealed a $95 million loan to refinance a newly built multifamily property in Brooklyn’s Gowanus neighborhood, Commercial Observer has learned.
brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits. The S&P 500 stands at 7,757.17 (up 0.6% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 19.0, a normal-volatility reading. The effective fed funds rate is 3.88%, the 10-year Treasury yield is 4.96% (down 17 bps on the prior reading) and the 10Y–2Y yield curve is +0.31 pts (positively sloped). High-yield credit spreads are 3.40%, near long-run norms (up 13 bps on the prior reading).
